SH332-W04-READY-RELEASE-UNIQUE-ADMISSION.equalTimeRule: No two actors share a phase in this fixture; any equal-time tie is processed by listed initiativeOrder with the prior slot's end processing before the next slot start.

logicalClock.calendarBinding: Every participant's start, one-time budget refresh, ordered non-overlapping slot end, exact six-second initiative phase, and spell-clock boundary is bound to replay events. W04 B prepares the spell on phase 0, A acts on phase 1000, then B releases by Reaction. The target is a stationary TEST_ONLY Construct. Death ends the call at 12000ms; absolute deadlines precede regular starts when offsets coincide.

state.presentOrExpresslyAuthorizedTestState: Expressly authorized hypothetical TEST_ONLY state for SH332-W03/W04; no presence or occurrence claim.

available.reason: one unique body at source, no active call, no outstanding return, and no reservation at this serialized baseline

competingReservationOrConcurrentCall.uniquenessRule: one identity key and one body; in W04, B's correctly Readied spell is held outside the active-call registry while A begins a later ordered ordinary cast. B's legal Reaction release reserves first; A's pending ordinary cast fails its final check and cannot create another body, reservation or call.

affirmativeConsentToExactCall.classification: TEST_ONLY explicit premise, not real consent
affirmativeConsentToExactCall.consentingIdentity: Lumen of the Shattered Thread (hypothetical test persona)
affirmativeConsentToExactCall.scope: For W03, the one described paid temporary call. For W04, B's TEST_ONLY Ready preparation on B's earlier ordered turn and one triggered Reaction release when A begins a later-turn cast: B selects Lumen at release, passes the then-current admission predicates and establishes the sole call; A's pending cast fails its final uniqueness check. Lumen consents to the successful same-arena/same-plane arrival, one permitted Thread Bind on its original regular initiative, the finite cargo, the 60-second deadline measured from Ready release, blocked return and independent recovery. Consent does not authorize a second movement, body, call, aid, or control.
exclusions: no transfer of another actor's action economy

permittedAidOrCommandScope.classification: TEST_ONLY consent premise bounded by the approved profile
permittedAidOrCommandScope.W03: One Thread Lance against TEST_ONLY_CREATURE_A on Lumen's next original regular initiative slot.
